kitDescription: Mori is a Wind AR Supporter whose kit revolves around a self-shield status called Struggle: at battle start she gives herself a permanent shield worth 40.12% of her Max HP, and while she holds it, landing 60 normal attacks taunts the enemy and her Burst II tops the shield back up. If the shield is ever lost she can re-create it by bursting, and each time Struggle ends she permanently gains stacking Max HP. Her burst always hands the whole team +10.16% Sustained damage for 10 seconds, and whenever anyone breaks an enemy part she stacks a small team-wide Sustained damage buff and plants a 15-second damage-over-time on the highest-ATK enemy. On the partless, non-damaging scope-lock boss her shield never breaks and no parts exist, so in practice she is a normal-attack damage dealer whose only live support contribution is the 10-second team Sustained-damage buff on each of her own burst casts.

Burst-slot line with no activation clause keys to the owner's own burstCast, not fullBurstEnter (SSOT §8; S2b's #1/#2 traps both avoided). Window is wall-clock 10s, not round-scoped, not permanent
burst.explanation: Fires on every mori cast in the sole-B2 fixture (>=4 casts/180s, strictly more often than chain completions), lands on all allies including self, expires exactly 600 frames after application. Discriminates against BOTH nearest-wrong models: fullBurstEnter rekey (fewer groups, FB-frame alignment) and generic attackDamagePct (leaks into jill's normal bucket in M2; S5's strip test keeps mori's own normals byte-identical).

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: all 9 kit lines are FAITHFUL (3) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (6), with the unmodeled set recorded verbatim plus reasons on both sides. The two independent blind re-derivations converged with the driver on the only live decision surface — S6's override is block-for-block identical to the shipped one, and the S5 adapted suite runs 12 PASS / 0 FAIL / 2 pre-registered GAP skips against it (the pristine artifact's module-load crash and shield-event reads are blind-side RECON_ERRORs, RE1–RE8, none attributable to the driver). The three shared-prior traps the S2b review named were all killed with discriminating evidence: the burst team buff is sustainedDamagePct on burstCast with an exact 10s window (counterfactuals for fullBurstEnter keying, generic bucket, and permanence all fail the shipped encoding), the part-destruction pair is dead rather than guessed-in, and the Struggle topology is correct-side-up (0 stacks, never 5; both not-in-Struggle branches silent). The residual the owner should spot-check is the one place driver and both blinds agreed by construction rather than by measurement: Struggle-as-requiresShielded proxy and 'recover Shield HP' encoded as a `shield` set-effect — both inert and unreachable-wrong at scope, but the shielded-event re-fire semantics would matter if a future teammate consumes 'when a shield is set' lines on mori, and the datamined cadence/gauge tuple (ammo 60, reloadFrames 81, gauge 20/40) remains unverified per S6's ⚑. Magnitudes are prose-exact everywhere (40.12/15.04/10.16/10s); nothing requires a measurement recipe for GO.
